extension.summary: AI Arcade for 32-bit Android Kodi: it teaches itself to play your NES games
extension.description:
The same AI Arcade screensaver as "AI Arcade", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a), as on many Fire TV sticks, Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV. Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app; install "AI Arcade" on 64-bit Android and macOS.
It picks a NES game from your ROMs, teaches itself to play it with no human input (finding gameplay, exploring, learning what progress means from the game's memory, then evolving NEAT neural networks) and shows the best player live with its progress. Everything learned is saved per ROM. Training on a TV stick is slow; expect many hours before a game shows clear progress.
You need your own .nes files (iNES format): put them in the add-on's roms folder, or choose another folder in the settings.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on built for Kodi 21 Omega on 32-bit Android. It includes the Nestopia emulator core (GPL-2.0-or-later), so the add-on is GPL-2.0-or-later. No ROMs are included. Training uses one CPU core at 60% by default (see Training in the settings).
